g.text: last4 : varchar(4) (text — leading zeros are real)
(liabilities negative, so net worth just sums)

category : varchar(80) (free text, not an FK)
(a limit, not a movement — always positive)
(null ⇒ trailing average of real INCOME rows)
Three invariants are in the schema from the first
migration because retrofitting them means rewriting
